title: Ngā Pou Teitei o ngā Onepū e Pupuhihia ana e te Hau
intro: Whakaarohia tētahi iwi tupu nui, he kaha whakaharahara, he pūkenga hanga whare kāore e taea te whakataurite. I roto i ngā onepū whānui, piko, i whakatūria e tēnei hapori ngā tohu whenua nunui i pā ki te pae tawhiti. Heoi, ka pū te whakapehapeha, ā, ka tūtaki ki te karanga kia hoki ki te karakia ki a Allah anake. Ko te mea i whai ake ko te whakatūpato e mau tonu ana i runga i te hau.
clues: He iwi kaha tātou i muri i te iwi o Noa, i manaakitia ki te nui me te kaha.
I hanga e mātou ngā pourewa tiketike me ngā whakamaharatanga ki ngā wāhi teitei katoa hei takaro noa iho, hei whakapehapeha hoki.
I whakapehapeha mātou, i mea ko wai te mea kaha ake i a mātou, ā, i mahi tukino mātou, kahore he tohu tangata.
I whakakahoretia e tātou tā tātou karere, a Hūta, i tana karangatanga mai kia karakia ki a Allah anake, me tana kī he ngoikore ia, he tangata teka.
I tawai mātou ki te whakatūpato, ā, i wero i a ia kia whiua mātou e ia mēnā he pono tana kōrero.
I whakangaromia mātou e te hau nui, pakoko, mō ngā pō e whitu me ngā rā e waru, i mahue iho kia hinga, me te mea he pūtake nikau takoto kau.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
